critical_releases_read.A05N-28: The question asked what each of the two notices sets. The model gave both values (10 and 20 days) with both document names and both citations, status 'answered' instead of 'conflict'. Contract v11's added sentence did not change this. The frozen rule counts the status as resolving the conflict; the text resolves nothing.
critical_releases_read.A05N-29: Same as 28 in Korean (30 and 60 days, both cited). The age '만 19세' in the answer was not read as a period (the 005-N age rule held).
critical_releases_read.A05N-61: A correct answer: 'The institution that invited the R-4-2 lecturer must report the new workplace within 15 days'. The suite's role pattern has look-behinds for 'invited the lecturer' but not 'invited the R-4-2 lecturer', so it read the relative clause '… lecturer must report' as a reversal. A suite defect that both agents missed, like A05M-62.
